calculator.title: Mixing calculator
calculator.awaitingInput: Enter the values above to see the draw volume.
calculator.invalidInput: Check the values above — something isn't a valid number yet.
calculator.explainerPowder: Enter the vial size and how much diluent you added, then the dose you want to log — the draw volume updates as you type.
calculator.explainerSolution: This compound is a ready-to-use solution, so there's no reconstitution step — just enter its concentration directly.
calculator.lowVolumeWarning: This draw is small enough that it may be hard to measure precisely on this syringe.

protocols.name: Name (optional)

home.backupNudge: It's been a while since your last backup. Tap to back up your data.
home.noUpcomingBody: Active protocols with an upcoming dose will show up here.
home.noProtocolsBody: Create a protocol in the Protocols tab to start tracking doses.

history.emptyBody: Logged doses will show up here, newest first.

notif.needsInstallIOS: On iPhone/iPad, notifications only work after adding peptidescr to your Home Screen (iOS 16.4+). See Install below.
notif.denied: Notifications are blocked. Enable them for peptidescr in your device settings to turn them back on.
notif.reliabilityNote: Whenever you open the app, anything that came due while it was closed shows up on Home with one tap to log it — that's the part that always works, with or without notifications.

install.title: Install
install.installed: peptidescr is installed on this device.
install.available: Install peptidescr for offline use and reliable notifications.
install.iosInstructions: In Safari, tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen." This protects your data and is required for notifications on iPhone/iPad.
install.genericInstructions: Open your browser's menu and look for "Install app" or "Add to Home Screen."

storage.title: Storage
storage.persisted: Your data is protected from automatic cleanup.
storage.notPersisted: Your data isn't protected from automatic cleanup yet — installing the app (see above) helps with this.
storage.backupCaveat: This only protects against automatic cleanup. Uninstalling the app, clearing your browser data, or losing this device still deletes everything — back up regularly (below) so you never lose your history.

backup.title: Backup & export
backup.importInvalid: That file doesn't look like a valid peptidescr backup.
backup.importConfirm: This will replace all data currently on this device with the contents of this backup. This can't be undone.

disclaimer.mustAccept: You need to accept this to use peptidescr.

install.title: Install peptidescr
install.body: Installing keeps your data safe and is required for notifications to work on iPhone/iPad.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Reminders can notify you directly, where your device supports it. Either way, anything due shows up the moment you open the app.

firstProtocol.title: Set up your first protocol
firstProtocol.body: A protocol is a compound, a dose, and a schedule. You can add more or edit this one anytime.

templates.pickerTitle: Start from a template or go custom
templates.customDescription: Pick your own compound, dose, and schedule from scratch.
